ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels occupying approximately 70% of the surface area, contrasted with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the fluke base, median notch, and perimeter boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity contiguous white lobes divided by a central, low-intensity dark triangular wedge extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Low-intensity dark banding follows the entire trailing edge and terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of roughly 12% of the fluke's total visible height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge, with increased pixel-amplitude peaks located at the primary lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature transitioning to a slight upward sweep as the contour approaches the distal terminal points of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, high-contrast pixel groupings located along the upper-right and upper-left trailing margins, indicating localized surface disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are scattered across the white intensity zones of both lobes, with a major concentration of unaligned marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across both ventral lobes; irregular low-intensity dark patches concentrated at the base of the fluke near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific 'anchor' or 'Y' shaped dark pigmentation pattern centered at the fluke hinge.
